import json, subprocess

def act(turn_deg, move_m):
    res = subprocess.run(['python3', '/app/act.py', json.dumps({'turn_deg': turn_deg, 'move_m': move_m})], capture_output=True, text=True)
    return json.loads(res.stdout)

# Current pose: (-0.5, 2.3), heading 270 (-x).
# Turn right 90 to face 0 (+y) and move forward 0.5 -> pose (-0.5, 2.8) -> obs 26
out26 = act(90, 0.5)

# Move forward 0.5 along heading 0 -> pose (-0.5, 3.3) -> obs 27
out27 = act(0, 0.5)
print('obs 27:', out27['frame'], out27['status'], out27.get('collision'))

# Turn left 90 to face 270 (-x) -> obs 28 (right facing the table!)
out28 = act(-90, 0)
print('obs 28:', out28['frame'], out28['status'], out28.get('collision'))
"
